Instruction: When using the 'codebase-memory-mcp' code intelligence server, always maintain a root '.cbmignore' file excluding high-churn files ('.agents/', 'docs/', build caches, test reports, and '.codebase-memory/') and configure 'auto_watch = false' (via 'codebase-memory-mcp config set auto_watch false') to prevent system stutters and constant background re-indexing during file editing.

Why: diagnosed mistake: used read_url_content to download Stitch JPG and HTML files — JPGs were corrupted (unreadable), HTML was not the raw source. Fix: always use Invoke-WebRequest for binary downloads.
